project: ktests gate — one command for the phase gate (ktests/tools/gate.sh)
status: planned — owner decisions DG1-DG8 taken, no code; base ktests e266334 (round 6 P4); owner 2026-10-19: commit the plan and start
workflow: per phase: one Opus worker -> supervisor review against the live tree (critic on G2 and at the end) -> ktests suite + full kbool sweep on bash 5.2.37 AND 5.3.9 -> commit (ktests first, then kbool bump; this ledger records the SHAs); process hygiene block in every brief; worker never commits

decisions.DG1: owner 2026-10-19: standalone tool ktests/tools/gate.sh next to timing_check.sh / strays.sh; ktests.sh interface unchanged
decisions.DG2: owner 2026-10-19: plain bash, no kbool/kkore/kklass dependency; fork-light
decisions.DG3: owner 2026-10-19: runtimes one after another by default; --parallel opt-in

decisions.DG6: owner 2026-10-19: --changed = touched suites + reverse kk.uses dependents; kkore/kklass/ktests/tests/kbool.sh change -> all
decisions.DG7: owner 2026-10-19: --rerun-failed N re-runs only failed files -> FLAKY verdict (off by default); ENV re-run once automatically
decisions.DG8: owner 2026-10-19: human lines + cells.tsv (primary, read by --compare) + summary.json (ledger record)
